caption: The video captures a backlit landscape in which a bright sun sits just above a thick, glowing layer of ground fog. A leafless tree spreads its bare branches across the lower center, while darker trees line the bottom-right edge. To the left, two lattice electrical transmission towers rise out of the mist, the farther one fainter than the nearer. Above, scattered grey-white clouds hang across a sky that opens into a patch of blue in the upper right, and a small dark shape intrudes at the very top edge. The sun, its glare, the cloud pattern, the fog, the trees, and the towers remain broadly stable, with no obvious displacement, deformation, or lighting shift discernible.
relations: Sun position and glare persist above the fog layer without shifting brightness or location.
Fog density and glowing horizon remain steady, keeping tower bases partially obscured.
Bare tree branches and dark treeline hold their shape and position across the lower frame.
Cloud pattern and blue sky patch stay fixed, with no deformation or drift visible.
